mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining (monthly change < 0) and below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST above 1200) combined with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 2.5%) creates a positive feedback loop for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: expansionary housing market with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1200 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an emerging supply-side slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in INDPRO (month-over-month) is followed by negative 60d returns in less than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% over three months signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 3.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST above 1200) indicates robust demand conditions, which typically support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when HOUST is above 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% over three months signals a supply-side shock, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE above 5.0%), elevated unemployment rates signal economic weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), SPX 60d returns are negative in less than 55% of cases.
